verdict.rationale: Poke is a personal AI assistant SaaS, and such products can plausibly offer team or organization workspaces, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no organization workspace, member management, role permissions, or org-level data policies. Merging personal accounts and disconnecting integrations are individual-user features, not team-admin controls.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can manage members, permissions, and data policies for my organization's workspace
